method: explicit positional simulation of log.json executions against plan.json declared dependencies

evidence_mapping.E-A: For each log entry the set of already-executed tasks is computed positionally (see simulation[].already_executed); the reported misordering is derived from that explicit walk, stopping at the first failing index (3).
evidence_mapping.E-B: unmet_dependencies at the failing index is the sorted set of merge's declared deps {validate, enrich} minus already-executed {fetch, parse, validate} = {enrich} = ["enrich"], already a singleton and thus trivially sorted.
evidence_mapping.E-C: The verdict follows mechanically: at least one index has a non-empty unmet-dependency set, so the log is MISORDERED; had every index been clean the verdict would have been WELL_ORDERED.
